_instruction: Template only. Do not populate with synthetic material. Each artifact is {path: relative to explicit evidence-root, sha256: lowercase 64 hex}; operational records also require passed:true. Every publication re-run must include studyId and candidateCommit. An independent-review entry also includes reviewerId, organization, declaredIndependent, signedDocumentReference and studyCoverage. Supplying hashes never proves authorship or scientific acceptance.
